title: Verdict
description: Stage 7 Jury output (verdict.json). Integer scores per SPEC rubric, each backed by a concrete screenshot observation, a pairwise check against the 30-night median piece, and a ranked top-3 critique. The harness checks that total equals the sum of scores and that ranks are 1, 2, 3.

mechanism.description: Embodies the research mechanism, not decoration.

ambition.description: Technical ambition for the size budget.

polish.description: Framing, timing, start and end states.

evidence.description: One concrete screenshot observation per criterion. Scores without evidence are discarded.

pairwise_beats_median.description: Does tonight beat the median-scored piece of the last 30 nights? A false here fails publish even with a high total.

pairwise_median_ref.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or anchor id of the median piece compared against. Null only when there is no archive yet.

calibration_anchors_used.description: Ids of the 4 rotating calibration anchors shown in the prompt.

critique.description: Top 3 changes that would raise the score most, rank 1 first.

evidenceText.description: A concrete observation from a named screenshot (t2, t8 or t20).
